newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas falls in winter, rises in summer '98.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas falls in winter, rises in summer '98.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures ended the week with a flurry of trade as 255 lots were traded at mixed levels in several different months.
The winter was generally lower, with October, January and February all losing ground while March traded and settled at the same level as on Thursday.
But further forward prices picked up, with April, June and July all closing up on the previous settlement level.
The five-lot deal in July 1998, at 10.40 pence a therm, was the first since the contract opened nearly a month ago.
Front month August was bid at 9.425 pence a therm and offered at 9.55 pence by the close.
A total of 1,055 lots traded over the week, averaging 211 lots a day. This compares with 1,475 lots at an average 295 lots a day traded last week.
